name: Assurio Social Publisher
author: assuriobv

sections.description:
Assurio Social Publisher shares WordPress posts to a Facebook Page and the Instagram professional account linked to it. Nothing is shared automatically: in the editor you tick per post which accounts it goes to, write a text per network if you want, pick an image and choose when.

What you get

  • A “Share on social media” box in the block editor and the classic editor.
  • Share when the post is published, at a set date and time, or right now.
  • Your own text per network, or a default text per language with placeholders: {title} {excerpt} {url} {category} {hashtags} {site_name} {author}.
  • Facebook: a link post. Facebook builds the preview from the Open Graph tags of your SEO plugin, and the plugin can ask Facebook to read the link again first.
  • Instagram: a photo post. The image is converted to JPEG and cropped automatically to a ratio Instagram accepts (between 4:5 and 1.91:1), so you never get the “aspect ratio” error.
  • Hashtags made from your tags and categories, with a maximum you choose and categories you can leave out.
  • UTM tags on the link, so you see the visits per network in Google Analytics.
  • Every account gets a post only once, unless you choose “share again”.
  • A status per account in the editor and a “Social” column in the posts list.
  • Automatic new attempts after a temporary error (after 5 minutes, 15 minutes and 1 hour).
  • A log of the last 300 actions and a daily check of the connection, with a warning in the dashboard when it stops working.
  • Test mode: nothing is posted, the text that would be posted goes to the log. You can force it on staging copies with define( 'ASSURIO_SP_TEST_MODE', true ); in wp-config.php.
  • Polylang and WPML: default texts and default accounts per language.
  • Translations: Dutch and French included.

Your own Meta app

The free plugin talks directly to Meta with your own Meta app. There is no server in between and no account with us. Creating the app takes about fifteen minutes; the Connection tab guides you step by step, checks the keys you paste and lists the values to fill in at Meta with a Copy button. For a company that posts on its own Page, Standard Access is enough: no App Review needed. Put the app live once the connection works (apps of type Business have no development mode), otherwise only people with a role on the app see the posts.

Pro

Social Publisher Pro is a separate add-on that connects Facebook and Instagram in one click (no Meta app needed) and adds Threads and LinkedIn company pages. The free plugin keeps working on its own without it.

External services

This plugin connects to Meta (Facebook and Instagram) to publish the posts you choose. It only contacts Meta when an administrator connects an account, when a post is shared, and once a day to check that the connection still works.

  • Facebook Login (www.facebook.com/dialog/oauth) and the Graph API (graph.facebook.com): used to connect your Facebook Page and Instagram account and to publish. Sent: the App ID, the access tokens, and for each share the text, the link to the post and, for Instagram, the address of the image on your site. Instagram downloads that image from your site. Facebook reads the post address to build the link preview.
  • Meta Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms/ , Meta Platform Terms: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/ , Instagram Terms of Use: https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870 , Meta Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Tokens and the App Secret are stored encrypted in your WordPress database. Nothing is sent to Assurio BV.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Social Publisher > Connection and follow the steps: create a Meta app, paste the App ID and App Secret, and click “Connect with Facebook”.
  3. Open a post, tick an account in the “Share on social media” box and publish, or click “Share now”.
sections.faq:
Does it post everything automatically?

No. Only the accounts you tick in the box of a post are used. In the settings you can pre-tick accounts per language, but you can always untick them.

Why does Instagram show “link in bio”?

Links in Instagram captions are not clickable. The default Instagram text therefore refers to the link in your bio. You can change the text per language.

My site is local or on a staging address.

Facebook posts work, but Instagram must download the image from a public address. Use test mode on local and staging copies.

Who owns the plugin?

Assurio BV, Belgium. The plugin is free software under the GPL version 2 or later.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public release: Facebook link posts, Instagram photo posts with automatic cropping, sharing on publish, at a set time or right now, default texts and accounts per language, UTM tags, retries, log, daily connection check, test mode, Dutch and French translations.
  • Developers: a networks registry (assurio_sp_register_networks) so add-ons can add networks.

short_description: Share the posts you choose to your Facebook Page and Instagram, with your own text, image and timing per post. Polylang and WPML aware.
